name: Ramp
tagline: Corporate cards and spend management. Loop: online assessment (often CodeSignal, multi-level), a live pair-programming phone screen, then a virtual onsite with coding, system design / frontend and a hiring-manager behavioral.
notes: Most reported: flight records (who flew most, where was a user at time t, solved with per-user sorted flights + binary search), the URL / HTTP maze (BFS over endpoints with cycles, retries and 401 keys), detecting recurring transactions in a card ledger, and a spreadsheet with concatenation formulas and cycle detection. CodeSignal-style multi-level class problems (task manager, banking ledger, recipe manager) also show up. Problems are practical rather than puzzles: interviewers expect complete, working, tested code, stated assumptions, explicit edge cases (empty input, exact-boundary timestamps, cycles), bounded retries, and code that extends cleanly to the next part. Some rounds allow an AI assistant but check that you understand what it wrote.
